in_sanskrit.name: Hetal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sunlight

The name Hetal signifies the one who radiates sunlight and illuminates the path of life with her wisdom and intelligence. It is also believed that the name Hetal is a form of the Goddess Hetai, who is worshipped for prosperity and success.
